outcome: Risk of developing placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: 81 pregnant women with PAS (27 primiparous and 54 non-primiparous).
finding: Increasing age, history of abortion, and history of myomectomy were identified as risk factors for developing PAS in primiparous women.
gest_age: Statistically significant difference in gestational week at delivery between patients with and without PAS
birth_weight: Statistically significant difference in birth weight between patients with and without PAS
